lesson: Zero-free finite stages are not an arithmetic property: the exponential of a truncated log series is zero-free for any Dirichlet series with a_1 = 1. A flag 'multiplicativity essential' needs a non-multiplicative control that fails the named step and no multiplicative control that fails it. Referee checks need exact arithmetic and complete zero lists: two faults in my own first script (float coefficients, 56 of 768 zeros missed) produced false failures before correction.
